preserved_development_failures.cause: The first adapter import used a module path that does not exist in vLLM 0.23.0; UnquantizedLinearMethod is in vllm.model_executor.layers.linear.
The initial synthetic expected values omitted local/global scale multiplication and reversed one nibble pair; the adapter matched the independent codec after correcting the test oracle.
Setuptools cannot build directly in a read-only source mount because it creates a local build directory; copying source to the disposable container's /tmp before pip install passed.
Calling upstream create_weights without a tensor-parallel process group is outside the device-free test contract; loading-after-process tests now construct serialized parameters directly.
A synthetic packed-weight fixture defaulted to int64 and was correctly rejected; setting the fixture to the checkpoint's uint8 dtype passed.

scope_limit: This proves package discovery, fail-closed registration, mixed-layer resolution, exact serialized weight reconstruction, and loading-after-process behavior. It does not prove full-model startup, activation-quantized semantics, NPU correctness, model accuracy, or performance.
